Bill.BriefDescription: Providing higher education degree production incentives.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to higher education degree production incentives;and adding a new section to chapter 28B.77 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.77 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The degree production incentive account is created in the statetreasury. Moneys in the account shall be spent only afterappropriation. All receipts from appropriations directed to theaccount must be deposited into the account. Expenditures from theaccount may be used only for degree production incentive purposes asidentified in subsection (2) of this section and distributed based ona formula in subsection (3) of this section. (2) Expenditures from the degree production incentive account shallbe for the purpose of providing incentives to the state universities,the regional universities, and The Evergreen State College to meetdegree production goals to increase: (a) Undergraduate degrees awarded; (b) Undergraduate degrees awarded in science, technology,engineering, and math (STEM), and high employer demand fields; p. 1 HB 2653 (c) Degrees awarded to lowincome students; and (d) The proportion of instate students accepted compared to outofstate students. (3)(a) Degree production incentive moneys must be disbursed to eachof the state universities, the regional universities, and The EvergreenState College according to the number of points earned. The method forearning points shall be based on the formula in this subsection (3). (i) One point will be earned for each undergraduate degree awarded; (ii) One point will be earned for each undergraduate degree awardedin science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM), and high employerdemand fields; and (iii) One point will be earned for each degree awarded to a lowincome student based on the student's eligibility for a federal Pellgrant. (b) The total number of institutional points shall equal the sum ofpoints earned in (a)(i) through (iii) of this subsection multiplied bythe acceptance rate of instate students. (4) The data used to determine points earned for degree productionincentive purposes shall be the same as used for the higher educationdata dashboard collected under RCW 28B.77.090 by the education datacenter in the office of financial management.
